title: Missed-Contact Service Credit, Real Estate Listing Orders
content:
On a failed sale of a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order, the seller receives a missed-contact service credit: a flat credit for listing-period service in which a contractor missed the contact window. It is subtracted from the failed-sale charge before the charge is floored at zero.

| Re-dispatches after a missed contact window recorded on the order | Missed-contact service credit |
|---|---|
| two or more | $75.00 |
| exactly one | $40.00 |
| none | no missed-contact service credit |

The count is taken from the contractor assignments recorded on the order: an assignment recorded as a re-dispatch after a missed contact window counts once. Initial assignments and recall assignments do not count.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical orders)

- An order with one initial assignment and one re-dispatch after a missed contact window on the same request: one re-dispatch, a credit of $40.00.
- An order with re-dispatches after a missed contact window on two different requests: two re-dispatches, a credit of $75.00.
- An order with four such re-dispatches: the credit stays $75.00; it is a flat amount, not a per-dispatch amount.
